build_unet_transformer_with_skip_connect: build a UnetTransformer with skip connections enabled for sequence processing with U-net style residual connections
build_unet_transformer_without_skip_conn: build a UnetTransformer without skip connections as a standard streaming transformer for sequence processing
build_unet_transformer_with_layer_dropou: build a UnetTransformer with layer dropout probability to randomly drop skip connections during training
run_unet_transformer_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the UnetTransformer on a batched sequence tensor with shape B x T x C
review_unet_transformer_skip_connection_: review the UnetTransformer skip connection logic that concatenates and projects features in the second half of layers
